name: olist_ecommerce_semantic_layer

gmv.label: GMV
gmv.definition: Sum of item price for effective orders, excluding freight

effective_orders.label: 有效订单量
effective_orders.definition: Purchased orders excluding canceled and unavailable orders

late_delivery_rate.label: 延迟配送率
late_delivery_rate.definition: Delivered orders arriving after the estimated date divided by comparable delivered orders

repeat_rate.label: 复购率
repeat_rate.definition: Users with at least two effective orders divided by users with at least one

guardrails: Only SELECT and WITH queries are generated
User text is never interpolated into SQL
Years are restricted to 2017 and 2018 comparable January-August periods
Unsupported or mutating requests are blocked
